overall: The Commission violated the Open Meeting Law by approving eight sets of 2022 minutes outside the timely-approval window; staffing shortages were not good cause, and no further order issued because the minutes were approved before the complaint.

allegations.summary: Alleged the Commission failed to timely approve the minutes of eight 2022 meetings; the Commission admitted late approval, citing staffing shortages.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find the Commission failed to timely approve the minutes of meetings held on July 13, 2022, July 27, 2022, August 10, 2022, August 24, 2022, September 14, 2022, October 12, 2022, October 26, 2022, and November 16, 2022.
